meta.title: Super Bowl LXI readiness, fictional FBO at LAX
meta.scope: Private aviation: Part 91 (FAA general aviation) + Part 135 (FAA air taxi). Airlines and military excluded.
meta.focus: Landings (arrivals), departures and parking. Staffing and fuel are out of scope for this site.

units.su: space unit = one light-jet parking position; midsize 1.5 su, large 2.5 su
units.movements: an arrival is a landing, a departure is a takeoff

meta.human_in_command: The system recommends; a named manager approves every action. It never accepts, refuses or cancels an individual aircraft or booking.
meta.never_allowed: Accept or refuse an individual aircraft, cancel a confirmed booking, authorize aircraft movements, commit money or activate facilities, or process passenger data.

data_classes.estimated: derived from measurements with stated assumptions

key_assumptions.name: FBO share of LAX private traffic
key_assumptions.note: 50% private-eligible x 20% capture. Ramp is sized to the same share, so ramp use does not depend on it.

key_assumptions.name: Ramp capacity
key_assumptions.note: Atlantic's 75 su ramp (2008 area) x share / Atlantic's 0.5 traffic share

key_assumptions.name: Space units light / midsize / large
key_assumptions.note: Checked against CJ3, Challenger 350 and G650 footprints

key_assumptions.name: Revenue lost per aircraft not accommodated

event_evidence.direction_assumption: FAA table has no directional split. Aircraft conservation: extra arrivals = extra departures = half the five-day excess operations; arrivals Thu-Sat plus half of game day, departures half of game day plus Monday.

standard.label: Normal operations
standard.method: 10000 Monte Carlo demand paths per scenario drawn from P2 point forecasts and assumed planning ranges mapped to 5th/95th percentiles, with a shared event shock. P2 expected counts are treated as medians. Parking prepared for the planning quantile. Impact compares normal plan vs prepared plan on the same paths.

security_restriction.label: Game-day security restriction 14:30-20:30
security_restriction.method: 10000 Monte Carlo demand paths per scenario drawn from P2 point forecasts and assumed planning ranges mapped to 5th/95th percentiles, with a shared event shock. P2 expected counts are treated as medians. Parking prepared for the planning quantile. Impact compares normal plan vs prepared plan on the same paths. Variant: no private movements on 2027-02-14 between 14.50 and 20.50 h (the data team's TFR input, https://www.faasafety.gov/files/notices/2022/Jan/SB_LVI_Flight_Advisory.pdf). Movements in that window are released over 4 h after it; 0% of blocked departures leave the next day. Same demand paths.

heavy_rain.label: Heavy rain on game day
heavy_rain.method: 10000 Monte Carlo demand paths per scenario drawn from P2 point forecasts and assumed planning ranges mapped to 5th/95th percentiles, with a shared event shock. P2 expected counts are treated as medians. Parking prepared for the planning quantile. Impact compares normal plan vs prepared plan on the same paths. Variant: heavy rain (at least 0.5 in) on day index 3. Completed operations change by -6.3% (measured on LAX heavy-rain days vs comparable dry days, NOAA x FAA 2016-2019 and 2023-2025, weighted Part 91 -9.8% / Part 135 -4.1%); the missing arrivals and departures happen the next day. About 5% of February days at LAX have heavy rain.

Low.early_arrival_finding: At 30% take-up, a cheap Thu-Fri slot moves the game-day P50 from 13.5 to 13.3 su and unaccommodated aircraft from 1.0 to 2.1: aircraft arrive earlier but leave at the same time, so they stay longer. It does not free parking.
Low.pricing_note: Past Super Bowls filled parking without raising prices (sources/docs/lax_private_capacity_and_cost_research.md); reservations (PPR) stay the primary tool, incentives are offers, and the system never refuses an aircraft.

actions.action: Offer a $500 drop-and-go credit to Super Bowl arrivals Thu-Sun: drop passengers, reposition to a partner field, return for pickup
actions.rationale: Without action 2.3 aircraft a run do not fit the 15 su ramp. If 10% of event arrivals accept: 2.0, net $380; if 30% accept: 1.6, net $1,002. Complements the ramp plan (tow-in packing, overflow lease); take-up is unknown

Medium.early_arrival_finding: At 30% take-up, a cheap Thu-Fri slot moves the game-day P50 from 17.4 to 17.3 su and unaccommodated aircraft from 2.3 to 4.3: aircraft arrive earlier but leave at the same time, so they stay longer. It does not free parking.
Medium.pricing_note: Past Super Bowls filled parking without raising prices (sources/docs/lax_private_capacity_and_cost_research.md); reservations (PPR) stay the primary tool, incentives are offers, and the system never refuses an aircraft.
